facebook_ads_vcc_overview.title_prefix: What is a Virtual Card for
facebook_ads_vcc_overview.description: A virtual card for Facebook Ads is a digital payment card created for advertising transactions. Instead of using one personal or business card for every ad account, you can create dedicated cards to separate budgets, manage payments, and keep advertising spend easier to track.

budget_control.title: Budget Control
budget_control.description: Assign different cards to different ad accounts, clients, or campaign groups.

payment_separation.title: Payment Separation
payment_separation.description: Keep ad payments separated instead of mixing every account on one main card.

digital_card.title: Digital card, real payments
digital_card.description: A virtual card works like a regular payment card, but it is created online and can be used for digital billing. For Facebook Ads, it helps you connect a dedicated card to your ad payment method without relying on a physical card.

ad_account_management.title: Built for ad account management
ad_account_management.description: When you manage many campaigns, clients, or business managers, one shared card can become hard to control. Virtual cards let you organize payments by account, campaign type, or team workflow.

billing_records.title: Cleaner billing records
billing_records.description: Each card can represent a specific advertising purpose. This makes it easier to review transactions, compare spending, and understand where your Facebook Ads budget is going.

function.title: How does it support Facebook Ads payments?
function.description: The card acts as a dedicated payment layer between your advertising budget and Facebook billing. It helps you separate spending, reduce confusion between accounts, and manage payment activity in a more structured way.

separate_payment_source.title: Separate payment source
separate_payment_source.description: Use one card for one ad account, client, or campaign group.

spend_tracking.title: Clearer spend tracking
spend_tracking.description: Review transactions by card instead of checking one mixed payment history.

shared_card_exposure.title: Less shared-card exposure
shared_card_exposure.description: Avoid using your main card across too many advertising accounts.

flexible_operation.title: Flexible operation
flexible_operation.description: Create, replace, or assign cards based on your advertising workflow.

step_02.description: Use the card as a payment method for your selected ad account or campaign workflow.

step_03.description: Track payments separately and keep your advertising budget easier to understand.
